## Open Theses {#sec-open-theses .section-heading}

::: {#thesis-listing}
:::

```{=html}
<div id="completed-theses-wrapper" style="display: none;">
```

::: {#thesis-completed}
:::

```{=html}
</div>
<div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 2rem;">
  <button id="show-completed-theses" class="btn-tuhh" style="cursor: pointer;">SHOW COMPLETED THESES</button>
</div>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  var btn = document.getElementById("show-completed-theses");
  var wrapper = document.getElementById("completed-theses-wrapper");
  var visible = false;
  btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
    visible = !visible;
    wrapper.style.display = visible ? "block" : "none";
    btn.textContent = visible ? "HIDE COMPLETED THESES" : "SHOW COMPLETED THESES";
  });
});
</script>
```
